# VC-HB-2410

Manufacturer: G&G Antriebstechnik GmbH.
Type: chain coupling 10B-2, z18, article 591-301-0018.
File: `591-301-0018.stp`.
The file is one fused solid. The chain cannot be taken out as links.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Torque | 380 Nm |
| Speed | 4500 1/min |
| Outside diameter | 107 mm |
| Hub diameter | 70 mm |
| Hub length | 30 mm |
| Overall length | 68 mm |
| Pilot bore | 14 mm |

Product page: https://www.gg-powertransmission.com/chain-couplings/product/591-301-0018/
CAD list: https://www.gg-powertransmission.com/chain-couplings/cad-files/
Downloaded: 2026-11-20.
Terms: G&G states no guarantee of completeness and no liability. Pictures may be simplified. No licence fee.

The file bore is along Z and is centred. Length 68 mm.
`Rot(-90, 0, 0)` lays that axis on Y.
The gearbox hub then faces −Y.
The assembly opens the pilot bore.
The gearbox half is Ø25.4 mm. The shaft half is Ø30.4 mm.
A keyway on +X clears the PLE120 key, which reaches X = 15.5 mm.
The purchase finish is 25H7 and 30H7. The model cut is clearance, not that finish.
